## BODY
Getting CBSE affiliation is the single biggest milestone for a new school. This guide breaks the process into plain steps.

## Who can apply

Your school must already be running up to at least middle school, with the required land, infrastructure and a registered society or trust behind it.

![The five stages of CBSE affiliation](/images/blog/cbse-affiliation-steps-infographic.png)

## The documents you'll need

| Document | Issued by |
|---|---|
| No Objection Certificate | State education department |
| Recognition certificate | State government |
| Building safety certificate | Local authority |

Keep certified copies of each — CBSE asks for originals during inspection.

## What it costs

Fees scale with the number of sections and the affiliation term.

![Typical affiliation costs by school size](/images/blog/cbse-affiliation-costs-infographic.png)

Budget for the inspection and annual fees on top of the one-time charge. Read the [official CBSE affiliation bye-laws](https://www.cbse.gov.in/affiliation) before you begin.
